fields.purpose: Primary psychometric symptom benchmark across cohorts and filters.
fields.where_used: Header KPI Cards, Vis 2 (Stress vs Anxiety), Vis 4 (Gender Comparison), Story Scene 1 & 2

fields.purpose: Secondary psychometric symptom benchmark across cohorts and filters.
fields.where_used: Header KPI Cards, Vis 3 (Stress vs Depression), Vis 4 (Gender Comparison), Story Scene 1 & 2

fields.purpose: Quantifies digital exposure and lifestyle immersion per cohort.
fields.where_used: Header KPI Card, Vis 6 (Screen Time vs Stress), Story Scene 1 & 3

fields.purpose: Primary cohort volume and proportional denominator.
fields.where_used: Header KPI Card, Vis 1 (Distribution), Vis 5 (Sleep), Vis 7 (History), Story Scenes 1-5

fields.tableau_formula: IF [Therapy Type] != 'No Therapy' THEN 'Enrolled in Therapy' ELSE 'No Therapy' END
fields.purpose: Segments active clinical intervention recipients from un-enrolled students.
fields.where_used: Vis 8 (Therapy Efficacy), Dashboard Therapy Section, Story Scene 5

fields.tableau_formula: IF [Stress Level] = 'High' THEN 'High Stress' ELSE 'Low or Moderate Stress' END
fields.purpose: Identifies urgent triage cases requiring clinical escalation.
fields.where_used: Dashboard Alerts, Story Scene 2, 3, 4 vulnerability analysis

fields.purpose: Composite metric capturing dual-manifestation comorbid distress load.
fields.where_used: Multivariate analysis, composite symptom correlation in Story Scene 2

fields.tableau_formula: IF [Age] <= 19 THEN '18-19 (Underclass)' ELSEIF [Age] <= 21 THEN '20-21 (Upperclass)' ELSE '22+ (Postgraduate/Senior)' END
fields.purpose: Demographic age binning preventing high-cardinality discrete noise.

fields.tableau_formula: IF [Therapy Type] != 'No Therapy' THEN [Progress Score] ELSE NULL END
fields.purpose: Computes true clinical improvement without zero-deflation from untreated students.
fields.where_used: Vis 8 (Therapy Efficacy), Dashboard Treatment Section, Story Scene 5

fields.tableau_formula: IF [Stress Level] = 'High' AND [Sleep Quality] = 'Poor' THEN 'High Risk (Severe Sleep Deficit)' ELSE 'Standard Risk' END
fields.purpose: Isolates the acute behavioral vulnerability cohort (71.4% of high stress).
